subject: Request: 3-week pilot addendum for throughput testing
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot addendum request: 3-week throughput window

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the great run so far — the team at BrightPath got solid signal from the initial evaluation. We need to extend the timebox to run a throughput-focused test and validate multi-region failover, but only for an additional 3 weeks. Two asks: (1) can you provide an addendum that extends the pilot by 3 weeks, and (2) we need a hard cap on monthly spend during the extension (procurement requirement).

We are comfortable with the same model/quantization profile you used; the key is guaranteeing a $ cap and a short-term invoice we can sign. Is there a standard addendum or short-form amendment you can share? I can loop procurement once I have the numbers.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Brooks
Director, Platform Engineering
BrightPath Health
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot addendum request: 3-week throughput window

Hi Evan — appreciate the note and glad the initial signals were useful.

Quick answer: yes, we can do a 3-week timebox addendum with a hard monthly spend cap. Two practical options we typically offer for this kind of short extension:

- Option A (timebox extension): +3 weeks to the current pilot, same per-token pricing, with a fixed cap of $8,500 for the extension period. We include one compliance deliverable (audit log snapshot) and 1x quick latency-run from our side.
- Option B (credit swap): Issue a $6,000 credit (redeemable only against hosted usage) and extend 3 weeks. This lowers upfront invoice friction for your procurement but the credit is non-refundable.

If procurement requires an invoice/PO, we can prepare a short addendum and attach an invoice for Option A. If you'd prefer the credit route we can issue a credit note and skip the PO step.

Cc'ing Marissa (sales lead on the account) to confirm commercial text and Dev to flag any capacity or kernel configuration concerns. We also attached a short throughput report from your baseline run and a draft addendum for review.

Next steps: confirm preference (Option A or B) and whether procurement needs DocuSign or a straight PO-based invoice.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: throughput-report.csv (summary), proposed-addendum.docx (draft)
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightPath Health Procurement <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot addendum request: 3-week throughput window

Thanks — that was fast. Procurement prefers Option A with an invoice/PO pairing; they also asked for a hard cap at $8,000 rather than $8,500. Can you absorb the $500 delta or confirm you need the $8,500 number?

Also procurement confirmed they will need the addendum on DocuSign and a short statement of SOW (single paragraph) that says: 'Redwood will extend the existing pilot by 21 calendar days with access to hosted inference for throughput validation; usage will be capped as outlined in the addendum.'

Let me know and I'll have procurement prepare the PO once the invoice/addendum are final.

Evan
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot addendum request: 3-week throughput window

Hi Evan — happy to make that work. We'll shift Option A cap to $8,000 and prepare a DocuSign addendum with the single-paragraph SOW you pasted.

Operational notes for your team: Dev flagged that the throughput run will spike concurrency across our dedicated hosted pools; we'll invest a one-time engineering credit to enable a temporary surgewatch profile and KV cache priming to keep latency within your required bounds. That engineering uplift is included in the $8,000 number (no extra charge).

Next items from us:
- I'll send the DocuSign addendum and invoice (net 30) by EOD tomorrow.
- Dev will post a short runbook for the throughput tests (expected warm-up 30–45 minutes).
- Marissa will include the addendum ID in HubSpot and mark the deal RDW-2026-BP-1127 as 'pilot-extension (signed)'.

If procurement needs a vendor form or W9, include procurement@brightpathhealth.com on that thread and we'll loop our finance team.

Thanks,
Priya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
